Name: Community Center Gym
Author: Unicornkiitty
Description:
Get ready to put the "Pec" back in Pelican Town! We're taking exercise to a whole new level by giving the Community Center a whole new floor! Say goodbye to your usual Tuesday routine and brace yourself for "Toned Tuesdays" at the Community Center! Not only does this mod add a new floor to the Center, but it also moves the Tuesday routine AND you can experience Harvey's 6 heart event here if you haven't already experienced it at Pierre's!

[code][IMG]https://i.postimg.cc/cHHZJ2LK/features.png[/IMG]
[/code]
[list]
[*]A Bedroom for those personal Custom NPC's you don't know where to home.
[*]Showers
[*]Gendered Locker Rooms
[*]A Bundle you can purchase before or after completing the Community Center! Although, access to the Gym floor [b]REQUIRES [/b]you to complete the Community Center. Better get to it!
[/list]
